info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to write,to scratch,to draw, to scribble

entries.artha_hindi: citra citAranA, spazwa rUpa se liKanA, viSeza rUpa se liKanA

examples: 'yA keSAn praliKati tasyE KalatiH' (pA0 sU0 2.3.62 vfttO).
'apAsyAH keSyaM malamapa SIrzaRyaM liKAt' (aTarva॰14.2.68). apa liKAt= ulliKyApAkuryAt.
'yaTA dantaprakzAlanotsAdanAvaleKanAnIti' (Apa0 Da0 112.8.5). avaleKanaM kaNkatAdinA keSAnAM viBAgenAvasTApanam.
'aYjanAByaYjanonmardastryavaleKAmizaM maDu' (BA0 pu0 7.12.12). avaleKA SarIramfjA, alaNkaraRam. anyatra durlaBo'trArTe prayogaH.
'bahuSo'valiKeccApi vartmAsyopagataM yadi' (suSruta0 uttara0 12.23). avaliKet viliKet ulliKet. vartma tuRqam. upagatamuccatAM gatamuparyAgatam.
'nirliKitaM dArumayam' (Apa0 Da0 1.5.17.12). nirliKitaM tazwaM sat prayatam.
rada vileKane iti DAtupAWaH. vileKanaM BedanaM Bavati. kzura vileKane iti ca. vileKanaM Cedanamiha vivakzitam.
'viliKati rahasi kuraNgamadena BavantaM samaSaraBUtam' (gIta0 4). viliKati citramAkaroti.
'niGnan proTena pfTivIM viliKaMScaraRErapi' (BA0 vana0 167.19). viliKan radan utkiran.
'nirBindantO ca gAtrARi viliKantO ca sAyakEH' (hari0). viliKantO kziRvantO.
'CAyAtapavileKaM ca' (BA0 ASva0 45.4). vileKaSCidram. CAyAtapO meGasantApO vileKAvutKAtArO yatreti tu nIlakaRWaH. utKAtArAvityapapAWaH, utKanitArAviti tu pAWaH.
'mano nizWASUnyaM Bramati ca kimapyAliKati ca' (mAlatI0 1.31). AliKati reKA utkirati.
'SfNgAByAmAliKandarpAd dvAraM dvirado yaTA' (rA0 4.9.62). AliKan utKanan apaskiramARaH.
'BUmO colliKati' (kA0 Sra0 7.3.28). SfNgeRa BUmO reKAM karotItyevArTaH.
'sa (citrakft) stamBaM vIkzya suSlakzRaM tatra gOrIM samAliKat. rUpakaropi SastreRa krIqayEvollileKa tam' (kaTA0 37.9).. ullileKa utkIrRavAn.
'alOkikatvAdamaraH svakoze na yAni nAmAni samullileKa' (trikARqa0). na samullileKa na ullileKa na nyAsa, nojjahAra.
'saMskArolliKito mahAmaRiriva kzIRopi na lakzyate' (SA0 6.5). saMskAraH SARaH. saMskriyate'neneti. ulliKito GfzwaH, tIkzRIkftaH, niSAyitaH.
'iti svahastolliKitaSca mugDayA rahasyupAlaByata candraSeKaraH' (ku0 5.58). ulliKita AliKita citre'rpitaH.

'saMmArjanopAYjanena sekenolleKanena ca. gavAM ca parivAsena BUmiH SuDyati paYcaBiH' (manu0 5.124).. ulleKanena KAtvA katipayamfdapanayanena. mAsapaYcatiTInAM ca nimittAnAM ca sarvaSaH. ulleKanamakurvARo na tasya PalaBAgBavet (Sabdakalpadrume samudDftaM tiTyAditattvam). ulleKanaM kIrtanam.
'pItvA ca madyamapi cekzurasapragAQam. niHSezataH kzaRamavasTitamulliKecca' (suSruta0 uttara0 47.17). ulliKet vamet.
'kftvApyananyasAmAnyamulleKaM nodgiranti ye' (kaTA0 78.115). ulleKo leKaH, utkIrya leKo vA.
'Aropya cakraBramamuzRatejAstvazwreva yatnolliKito viBAti' (raGu0 6.32). yatnosliKitaH prayatnena SARe GfzwaH.
'DAtrABiliKitAnyAhuH sarvaBUtAni karmaRA' (BA0 strI0 7.12). aBiliKitAni sarvato nyastAni. tattallakzaREH pfTagavasTApitAni.
'sPyena padaM triH pariliKati' (kA0 SrO0 7.6.17). parito reKAM karotItyarTaH.
'pariliKitaM rakzaH pariliKitA arAtayaH' (tE0 saM0 1.2.5.1). pariliKitaM reKAcakreRa parivezwitam. nASitamititvArTiko'rTaH.
